newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Daily Star newspaper reborn.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Daily Star newspaper reborn.

text.p: Lebanon's English-language daily newspaper, The Daily Star, reappeared on newstands on Tuesday, 11 years after closing down during the 1975-90 civil war.
Founded in 1952 by Kamel Mroue, father of publisher Jamil Mroue, The Daily Star shut down in 1976 soon after the war began.
It reopened in 1983 during a lull in the fighting but closed again early in 1985 amid a wave of kidnaps, car bombings, assassinations and heavy fighting in Beirut between sectarian militias.
